name: The Kinks

whyMatters.en: London Invasion band whose 1964 Pye singles used sliced-speaker distortion and two-chord riffs; later Ray Davies songwriting (Waterloo Sunset, Lola) turned English observational detail into rock grammar.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦 Invasion 乐队：1964 年 Pye 单曲用划破扬声器的失真与两和弦 riff；后期 Ray Davies 写作（Waterloo Sunset、Lola）把英式观察细节写进摇滚语法。

essentialTracks.title: All Day and All of the Night

lyricQuotes: Girl, you really got me going / You got me so I don't know what I'm doing
Dirty old river, must you keep rolling / Flowing into the night

shortBio.en: Davies brothers Invasion rock; You Really Got Me is the distortion riff prototype, Ray Davies the English character writer.
shortBio.zh: Davies 兄弟的 Invasion 摇滚；You Really Got Me 是失真 riff 原型，Ray Davies 是英式角色写作核心。

body.en:
Formed 1963 in London. Early Pye singles (You Really Got Me, All Day and All of the Night) used Dave Davies’s sliced-speaker grind and Ray’s two-chord hooks—cited by Van Halen and garage/hard-rock catalogs as a distortion template.

Mid-period Ray Davies albums (Face to Face, Something Else, The Kinks Are the Village Green Preservation Society) shifted to English observational pop. Lola (1970) kept narrative songwriting on US/UK charts after the Invasion peak.
body.zh:
1963 年于伦敦组建。早期 Pye 单曲（You Really Got Me、All Day and All of the Night）用 Dave Davies 划破扬声器的碾磨与 Ray 的两和弦钩子——被 Van Halen 与 garage/hard-rock 目录引为失真模板。

中期 Ray Davies 专辑（Face to Face、Something Else、The Kinks Are the Village Green Preservation Society）转向英式观察流行。Lola（1970）在 Invasion 高峰后仍把叙事写作送上英美榜。

note.en: Dave Davies sliced amp speaker; two-chord power-chord riff on Pye 45.
note.zh: Dave Davies 划破音箱；Pye 45 上的两和弦强力和弦 riff。

note.en: Ray’s observational lyric over clean arpeggios; Village Green era pivot.
note.zh: Ray 观察式歌词配干净琶音；Village Green 时期转向。

note.en: Acoustic intro into electric chorus; narrative gender detail on RCA single.
note.zh: 原声前奏接电声副歌；RCA 单曲上的叙事性别细节。

title.en: Distortion singles to English character albums
title.zh: 失真单曲到英式角色专辑

body.en:
You Really Got Me (1964) is the hard-rock citation: power chords, amp abuse, minimal verse-chorus. Ray Davies then built a parallel lane—Waterloo Sunset’s clean detail, Village Green’s domestic English frames.

Same band, two methods: riff violence vs observational songwriting.
body.zh:
You Really Got Me（1964）是 hard-rock 引用：强力和弦、音箱虐待、极简主副歌。Ray Davies 另开一条线——Waterloo Sunset 的干净细节、Village Green 的英式日常框架。

同一支乐队，两种方法：riff 暴力 vs 观察式写作。

title.zh: 经典四人组至 Quaife 离队

body.en:
Peak Invasion silhouette: Ray vocals/rhythm, Dave lead grind, Quaife bass, Avory drums. Quaife exits 1969; Avory stays through the 1970s chart singles.

Later lineups rotate bass and second guitar; Davies brothers remain the fixed axis until the 1990s.
body.zh:
Invasion 峰值剪影：Ray 人声/节奏、Dave 主音碾磨、Quaife 贝斯、Avory 鼓。Quaife 1969 年离队；Avory 贯穿 1970 年代榜单单曲。

后期阵容轮换贝斯与第二吉他；Davies 兄弟仍是 1990 年代前的固定轴。

title.en: Riff template and Britpop character debt
title.zh: Riff 模板与 Britpop 角色债

body.en:
Garage and hard-rock acts cite You Really Got Me’s distortion method. Blur and Oasis inherit Ray Davies’s English character writing and mid-tempo chord moves more than the early grind alone.

The Kinks sit on both the power-chord family tree and the observational Britpop lyric line.
body.zh:
Garage 与 hard-rock 引用 You Really Got Me 的失真方法。Blur 与 Oasis 继承 Ray Davies 的英式角色写作与中速和弦进行，不止早期碾磨。

The Kinks 同时站在强力和弦谱系与观察式 Britpop 歌词线上。
